unit.label: Dorms, floors & campus buildings
unit.title: Finding Places on Campus
unit.description: 12 new words and forms. Find dorms and classrooms, describe floors, and distinguish front, behind and beside.

goal.text: 圖書館旁邊的教室在二樓。
goal.pinyin: Túshūguǎn pángbiān de jiàoshì zài èr lóu.
goal.meaning: The classroom beside the library is on the second floor.

unit.bookReference: A Course in Contemporary Chinese 1 · Lesson 6, pp. 104–115; corrective 不是, pp. 117–118. Original examples and exercises.

lessons.title: At the Dorm
lessons.subtitle: Name a dorm and a numbered floor.

steps.explanation: Use the digit 二 for a floor label. It is different from counting two objects.

steps.prompt: Where is the restaurant in 餐廳在宿舍的一樓？
options: On floor one of the dorm
On floor two of the library
steps.answer: On floor one of the dorm
steps.explanation: 宿舍 names the building; 一樓 names its floor.
樓 is lóu, meaning floor or storey.

lessons.title: Upstairs or Downstairs?
lessons.subtitle: Use the current place as your reference.

steps.prompt: You are on floor four. A friend says 我在樓下. What can you conclude?
options: The friend is on a lower floor; the exact floor is unstated.
The friend must be on floor one.
The friend is on a higher floor.
steps.answer: The friend is on a lower floor; the exact floor is unstated.
steps.explanation: 樓下 is relative to the understood place, not a fixed floor number.

steps.prompt: Which asks for a floor number?
steps.explanation: 幾樓 asks which numbered floor.
下 is xià: down or below, as in 樓下.

steps.prompt: Which means “two buildings,” rather than floor two?
steps.explanation: 兩 counts two objects before the building measure 棟. 二樓 is a floor label.

steps.prompt: Which question needs a building as its answer?
steps.explanation: 哪棟大樓 asks which building is the dorm.
棟 is dòng. Its right side is the familiar 東, but the tone is different.

lessons.title: In Front or Behind?
lessons.subtitle: Separate a location from a noun description.

steps.prompt: Which phrase names a location in front of the library?
steps.explanation: The library is the reference point, followed by 前面.

steps.prompt: What is the main thing named by 宿舍後面的餐廳?
steps.explanation: 餐廳 comes last. 宿舍後面的 describes which restaurant.
後 is hòu: back or behind.

lessons.title: Beside the Library
lessons.subtitle: Find a classroom and correct a location.

steps.prompt: How is 教 pronounced in 教室?
steps.explanation: Classroom is jiàoshì. The verb teach in 教中文 is jiāo.

steps.prompt: Read: 教室不是在二樓，教室在三樓。 Which floor is correct?
steps.explanation: The first clause rejects floor two; the second supplies floor three.

steps.prompt: Which location word specifically says “beside,” rather than simply somewhere nearby?
steps.explanation: 旁邊 specifies the side of the landmark.
室 is shì, with a falling fourth tone. It is the second character of 教室.

lessons.title: Welcome to Our School
lessons.subtitle: Introduce another facility and put the locations together.

steps.prompt: Why is 游泳 written twice in 我在游泳池游泳？
options: One is part of the place word; the other is the action.
steps.answer: One is part of the place word; the other is the action.
steps.explanation: 在游泳池 gives the place; the final 游泳 gives the activity.

steps.prompt: A visitor has come to your school. Which expression welcomes them?
steps.explanation: 歡迎 welcomes the visitor, and 來 matches the host’s viewpoint.
池 is chí: pool.

lessons.title: A Short Campus Visit
lessons.subtitle: Read and explain a simple campus arrangement.

steps.prompt: Read: 商店在宿舍前面。 Which building is the reference point for “in front”?
steps.explanation: 宿舍 comes immediately before 前面.

steps.prompt: Read: 餐廳在宿舍的一樓。朋友在三樓。 From your friend’s floor, is the restaurant upstairs or downstairs?
steps.explanation: Floor one is lower than floor three.

steps.prompt: Read: 圖書館後面有游泳池，旁邊有商店。 What is behind the library?
steps.explanation: The first location clause puts the swimming pool behind the library.

steps.prompt: Which names the classroom beside the library, rather than the area beside the classroom?
steps.explanation: The main noun 教室 comes last; the preceding location describes it.

steps.prompt: Your friend says the restaurant is on floor two, but it is on floor four. Which correction gives the right floor?
options: 餐廳不是在二樓，餐廳在四樓。
餐廳不是在四樓，餐廳在二樓。
steps.answer: 餐廳不是在二樓，餐廳在四樓。
steps.explanation: Reject the mistaken second-floor claim, then give the fourth floor.

宿.meaning: lodging; first character of 宿舍
宿.note: In 宿舍, 宿 is sù. It refers to lodging here; other readings belong to other words.
宿.memory: A roof 宀 covers a small person 亻 beside 百: picture lodging under the roof.

parts.label: 宀
parts.name: roof
parts.description: The roof has a top dot, a left dot and a horizontal hook sheltering everything below.

parts.label: 亻
parts.name: person at the left
parts.description: The narrow person component stands under the left side of the roof.

parts.label: 百
parts.name: lower right block
parts.description: 百 has a horizontal cap above 白; the rectangular lower section contains a middle bar.

舍.meaning: dwelling; second character of 宿舍
舍.note: 舍 is fourth-tone shè in 宿舍. Keep it distinct from other readings and from the separate character 捨.
舍.memory: Two spreading roof-like strokes sit above 干 and 口 in 舍.

parts.label: 𠆢
parts.name: top cover
parts.description: The two top strokes spread left and right over the middle bar.

parts.label: 干
parts.name: middle cross
parts.description: Two horizontal strokes crossed by a vertical form the middle group.

parts.label: 口
parts.name: bottom box
parts.description: The three-stroke 口 closes the base directly under the middle vertical.

樓.note: 樓 names a floor in 二樓. 大樓 names a multi-storey building; the two uses share this character.
樓.memory: A narrow tree 木 stands beside the dense 婁 block, whose bottom resembles 女.

parts.label: 木
parts.name: wood component
parts.description: The left 木 narrows its right-falling stroke to make room for 婁.

parts.label: 婁
parts.name: right sound component
parts.description: The upper bars and boxes stack above a 女-shaped base; keep the central vertical aligned.

下.note: 下 means below or down in 樓下. Here it identifies a lower floor relative to the understood place.
下.memory: A long horizontal roof, a vertical descending beneath it, and a short stroke to the right.

parts.label: 一
parts.name: top bar
parts.description: Write the long top horizontal first; the other two strokes hang beneath it.

parts.label: 卜
parts.name: lower group
parts.description: A vertical drops from the top bar. Add the short rightward stroke beside it.

棟.note: 棟 counts whole buildings: 一棟大樓. Its right side is 東, already taught in 東西.
棟.memory: 木 beside 東: a familiar tree at left and the crossed box of 東 at right.

parts.label: 木
parts.name: wood component
parts.description: Four strokes form a narrow 木 at the left; its final stroke is shortened.

parts.label: 東
parts.name: right sound component
parts.description: The eight-stroke 東 contains a central box crossed by a vertical, with two spreading strokes below.

前.note: 前 means front. In 前面, it names the front or the area in front of a reference point.
前.memory: Remember 前 by the two short strokes and bar at the top, above a box-like left side and a slim right hook.

parts.label: 䒑
parts.name: top group
parts.description: The top group has two short strokes above a long horizontal bar.

parts.label: lower
parts.name: lower group
parts.description: Below the bar, a 月-shaped group sits on the left and two upright strokes sit on the right.

後.note: 後 is the Traditional character in 後面. This unit uses its spatial meaning, behind.
後.memory: A narrow 彳 stands beside 幺 over three spreading lower strokes in 後.

parts.label: 彳
parts.name: left step component
parts.description: Two short left-falling strokes precede the long left-side vertical.

parts.label: 幺
parts.name: upper right component
parts.description: Two bent strokes and a small dot form 幺 above the lower crossing strokes.

parts.label: 夊
parts.name: lower right component
parts.description: The three lower strokes cross and spread at the bottom right.

旁.meaning: side; first character of 旁邊
旁.note: 旁 is second-tone páng in 旁邊, beside. The lower 方 is already familiar.
旁.memory: A broad upper cover shelters 方 at the bottom of 旁.

parts.label: 六
parts.name: top group
parts.description: A dot and horizontal bar sit over two short spreading strokes.

parts.label: 冖
parts.name: middle cover
parts.description: Two strokes make a shallow cover between the top group and 方.

parts.label: 方
parts.name: lower component
parts.description: Write the familiar four-stroke 方 below the cover.

邊.note: 邊 forms the second syllable of 旁邊. This Taiwan guide uses 19 strokes.
邊.memory: A tall 臱 block stands above the wrapping 辶, with 自 at its top and 方 near its base.

parts.label: 臱
parts.name: inner block
parts.description: Start with 自, then the middle roof and short spreading strokes, and finish with 方 below.

parts.label: 辶
parts.name: movement component
parts.description: Four strokes wrap the left and bottom; the final sweep supports the tall inner block.

室.note: 室 is shì in 教室, classroom. The upper roof suggests an indoor space.
室.memory: A roof 宀 shelters 至, the same block seen at the left of 到.

parts.label: 宀
parts.name: roof
parts.description: The three roof strokes cover the lower block without touching its central vertical.

parts.label: 至
parts.name: lower block
parts.description: 至 has a horizontal cap, a bent stroke and dot, then a 土-shaped base.

池.note: 池 names a pool in 游泳池. The familiar swimming activity gains a place word.
池.memory: Water 氵 flows down the left of the wide 也 on the right.

parts.label: 氵
parts.name: water component
parts.description: Two dots and a rising stroke make the left-side water component.

parts.label: 也
parts.name: right component
parts.description: 也 begins with its wide hooked turn, followed by a central vertical and the low turning hook.

迎.note: 迎 is second-tone yíng in 歡迎. 歡 is already familiar from 喜歡.
迎.memory: The compact 卬 block sits above the wrapping movement component in 迎.

parts.label: 卬
parts.name: inner component
parts.description: A slanted top and upright turn face a narrow hooked right section.

parts.label: 辶
parts.name: movement component
parts.description: Four strokes wrap left and below 卬; finish with the long supporting sweep.

u20-dorm.title: A place where students live
u20-dorm.explanation: 宿舍 sùshè means dormitory. 學生宿舍 is a student dormitory. Say 在宿舍 to locate someone there. Learn both characters together: 宿 is sù and 舍 is shè in this word.

examples.meaning: I am at the dorm now.

u20-dorm.remember: Use the whole word 宿舍, not either character on its own.

u20-floor.title: Name the floor directly
u20-floor.pattern: number + 樓; building + 的 + number + 樓
u20-floor.explanation: 樓 lóu names a floor. 一樓 is floor one, the ground level in Taiwan; 二樓 is floor two. These are floor labels, so use 二樓, not 兩樓, for the second floor. Do not insert 個. In 宿舍的一樓, 宿舍 names the building and 一樓 names the floor within it.

examples.pinyin: Cāntīng zài sùshè de yī lóu.
examples.meaning: The restaurant is on the first floor of the dorm.
My friend is on the second floor.

u20-floor.remember: Use a floor number directly before 樓. 一樓 names the first floor, not one entire building.

u20-up-down.title: Relative floors
u20-up-down.pattern: 在 + 樓上 / 樓下; 去 + 樓上 / 樓下
u20-up-down.explanation: 樓上 lóushàng is upstairs and 樓下 lóuxià is downstairs. These are fixed location words: do not insert 的 inside them. They refer to a higher or lower floor relative to the place understood in the conversation; they do not always mean floor two and floor one.

examples.meaning: My friend is downstairs.
I want to go upstairs.

u20-up-down.remember: 在 gives the location; 去 describes going there. 樓上/樓下 depend on the reference floor.

u20-floor-question.title: Ask for the floor number
u20-floor-question.explanation: 幾樓 asks which floor. Put 幾 directly before 樓, as in 幾樓. Answer with a number and 樓. This gives a numbered floor rather than the relative direction upstairs or downstairs.

examples.meaning: Which floor are you on?
I am on the third floor.

u20-floor-question.remember: Do not add 個 or 嗎 to this 幾樓 question.

u20-buildings.title: A whole building, not a floor
u20-buildings.pattern: 這 / 那 + 棟 + 大樓; number + 棟 + 大樓
u20-buildings.explanation: 大樓 dàlóu means a multi-storey building. Use the measure word 棟 dòng when counting or pointing to buildings: 這棟大樓, 那棟大樓, 兩棟大樓. Contrast 兩棟大樓, two buildings, with 二樓, floor two.

examples.meaning: This building is a dormitory.

examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng dòng dàlóu hěn xīn.
examples.meaning: Those two buildings are new.

u20-buildings.remember: Use 棟 for whole buildings, and a number directly before 樓 for a floor.

u20-which-building.title: Identify the building you mean
u20-which-building.explanation: You know 哪 asks which before a measure word. Pair it with 棟: 哪棟大樓 means which building. 哪棟大樓是圖書館？ asks you to identify the library building; it does not ask which floor the library is on.

examples.meaning: Which building is the library?

u20-which-building.remember: 哪棟 asks which building; 幾樓 asks which floor.

u20-front-back.title: Use a landmark as the reference
u20-front-back.explanation: 前面 qiánmiàn means in front and 後面 hòumiàn means behind. Name the landmark first: 圖書館前面 is in front of the library; 圖書館後面 is behind it. A building’s usual front or an agreed viewpoint supplies the orientation. Without a landmark, 前面 or 後面 uses the understood viewpoint.

examples.meaning: The shop is in front of the dorm.
The restaurant is behind the library.

u20-front-back.remember: Put the reference point before 前面 or 後面. This lesson uses spatial front/back, not time.

u20-location-modifier.title: The place versus the thing there
u20-location-modifier.pattern: 圖書館前面 ↔ 前面的圖書館
u20-location-modifier.explanation: 圖書館前面 is a location: in front of the library. 前面的圖書館 is a noun phrase: the library in front. In the second pattern, 前面 describes 圖書館 through 的; the main thing you are naming comes last. You can also say 宿舍前面的商店: the shop in front of the dorm.

examples.meaning: The library in front is large.

examples.pinyin: Sùshè qiánmiàn de shāngdiàn hěn jìn.
examples.meaning: The shop in front of the dorm is near.

u20-location-modifier.remember: Changing what comes last changes whether you name a location or the thing there.

u20-beside.title: Next to a landmark
u20-beside.explanation: 旁邊 pángbiān means beside or next to. Like 前面 and 後面, it follows the reference point. 旁邊 is more specific than 附近: it places something at the side of the landmark, rather than somewhere in its surrounding area.

examples.meaning: The shop is beside the library.

u20-beside.remember: 旁邊 names the side; 附近 names a nearby area.

u20-classroom.title: A room for class
u20-classroom.explanation: 教室 jiàoshì means classroom. 教 has fourth tone jiào in this word, unlike first-tone jiāo in 教中文, teach Chinese. You already know 上課. 我們在教室上課 says we have class in the classroom. Use 個 to count classrooms.

examples.meaning: We have class in the classroom.

examples.pinyin: Èr lóu yǒu sān ge jiàoshì.
examples.meaning: There are three classrooms on the second floor.

u20-classroom.remember: Learn jiàoshì as a whole word; do not carry the jiāo pronunciation over from 教中文.

u20-correction.title: Correct what someone has assumed
u20-correction.pattern: 不是 + mistaken claim，… + corrected claim
u20-correction.explanation: 不在 simply says not at a place. Here 不是在 explicitly rejects an assumed location and can be followed by the correction. If someone thinks the classroom is on floor two, 教室不是在二樓，教室在三樓 corrects that claim. 不是 is not a replacement for every 不 or 沒有.

examples.text: 教室不是在二樓，教室在三樓。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshì bú shì zài èr lóu, jiàoshì zài sān lóu.
examples.meaning: The classroom is not on the second floor; it is on the third.

u20-correction.remember: Give enough context to show which claim is being corrected. Both 不在 and corrective 不是在 can be valid.

u20-pool.title: An activity and its place
u20-pool.pattern: 游泳 + 池 → 游泳池
u20-pool.explanation: You already know 游泳, swim. Adding 池 chí, pool, gives the place 游泳池. In 在游泳池游泳, the first 游泳 belongs to the place word; the last 游泳 is the activity. Use 個 to count swimming pools.

examples.meaning: I swim in the swimming pool.

examples.text: 圖書館後面有一個游泳池。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn hòumiàn yǒu yí ge yóuyǒngchí.
examples.meaning: There is a swimming pool behind the library.

u20-pool.remember: 游泳 is the activity; 游泳池 is the facility. The repeated-looking sentence has two different jobs.

u20-welcome.title: Welcome someone here
u20-welcome.explanation: 歡迎 huānyíng means welcome. In 歡迎你們來我們學校, the people being welcomed follow 歡迎, and 來 introduces their coming here. 歡 is already familiar from 喜歡; only 迎 is a new character.

examples.meaning: Welcome to our school!

u20-welcome.remember: 歡迎 is a welcome, not a goodbye or a statement of someone’s skills.

u20-two-buildings.pinyin: Nà liǎng dòng dàlóu hěn xīn.

u20-food-behind.meaning: The restaurant is behind the library.

u20-shop-modifier.meaning: The shop in front of the dorm is near.

u20-beside-library.meaning: The shop is beside the library.

u20-classroom-study.meaning: We have class in the classroom.

u20-classroom-floors.pinyin: Èr lóu yǒu sān ge jiàoshì.
u20-classroom-floors.meaning: There are three classrooms on the second floor.

u20-correct-floor.text: 教室不是在二樓，教室在三樓。
u20-correct-floor.pinyin: Jiàoshì bú shì zài èr lóu, jiàoshì zài sān lóu.
u20-correct-floor.meaning: The classroom is not on the second floor; it is on the third.

u20-pool-behind.text: 圖書館後面有一個游泳池。
u20-pool-behind.pinyin: Túshūguǎn hòumiàn yǒu yí ge yóuyǒngchí.
u20-pool-behind.meaning: There is a swimming pool behind the library.

u20-beside-classroom.meaning: The classroom beside the library is large.
